root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a separate check `offset >= memslot->npages` before the addition; the commit message details how `offset = 0xffffffffffffffc1` and `__fls(mask) = 63` yields a sum of 0, passing the original check and leading to an out-of-bounds load from `slot->arch.rmap[0][]`.
